releases.name: v0.4.0
releases.notes:
## Installation

Download the tarball for your PostgreSQL version and architecture, then:

```bash
tar -xzf pg_stat_ch-*.tar.gz
cd pg_stat_ch-*/
sudo cp pg_stat_ch.so $(pg_config --pkglibdir)/
sudo cp pg_stat_ch.control pg_stat_ch--*.sql $(pg_config --sharedir)/extension/
```

See INSTALL.md in the tarball for full instructions.

## Debug Symbols

Debug symbol packages (`*-debuginfo.tar.gz`) are provided for crash analysis.
To use them with a core dump:

```bash
tar -xzf pg_stat_ch-*-debuginfo.tar.gz
gdb -ex "set debug-file-directory $(pwd)" -ex "bt" pg_stat_ch.so core
```


## What's Changed
* refactor(exporter): remove dead MetricFixedString interface method + FixedStringCol class by @JoshDreamland in https://github.com/ClickHouse/pg_stat_ch/pull/114
* refactor(exporter): rename Tag/Metric/Record column interface to StatLC/StatHC by @JoshDreamland in https://github.com/ClickHouse/pg_stat_ch/pull/115
* update clickhouse-c by @serprex in https://github.com/ClickHouse/pg_stat_ch/pull/118
* mallopt(M_ARENA_MAX, 4) by @serprex in https://github.com/ClickHouse/pg_stat_ch/pull/119
* update dependencies, don't statically link openssl by @serprex in https://github.com/ClickHouse/pg_stat_ch/pull/120
* feat(exporter): unified Arrow exporter with GUC + end-to-end TAP test by @JoshDreamland in https://github.com/ClickHouse/pg_stat_ch/pull/116
* test: producer-to-collector routing on pg_stat_ch.block_format by @JoshDreamland in https://github.com/ClickHouse/pg_stat_ch/pull/117
* chore(release): bump to 0.4.0 with no-op PG migration by @JoshDreamland in https://github.com/ClickHouse/pg_stat_ch/pull/123


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ClickHouse/pg_stat_ch/compare/v0.3.11...v0.4.0
